what_this_is: The Workshop rows for the person's posts in tools/social-posts, read from their own post records through the run's records door.

payload.label: Posting calendar
payload.job: Show what this person is posting between two times, and which drafts have no time yet, so a post can be given a time or moved to another
payload.description: Give from and to (dates and times with their zone). Returns posts: each post whose scheduled time falls in between (or, sent without a time, when it was sent), earliest first, with at, status, words and can_move; and unscheduled: the drafts and approved posts with no time yet. A post gets a new time through draft_post with post_id and scheduled_for, which makes an approved or scheduled post a draft again to approve. Its screen is the month and hour calendar, where a post is dragged to its time.

from.description: The start of the span, like 2026-10-01T00:00:00-04:00

to.description: The end of the span, after from

provenance.source: trillion media-workspace scheduled-calendar.mjs and calendar-placement.mjs (the Mac's Schedule month, week and day views), rebuilt on src/social-posts.mjs calendar, the same read list_post_calendar makes (a2fdfe6), ported to the records door

screen.label: Posting calendar
screen.about: When each of your posts goes out.

payload.label: How each post did
payload.job: Show how each of this person's published posts did in each place it went: that place's own counts, the visitors its link brought and what they bought
payload.description: Give observations (each place's own counts for a post, read with that place's tools: { post_id, account_id, metrics: { name: number }, observed_at } or { platform_post_id, account_id?, metrics }), visits and conversions (as tool:break-down-visits-and-sales takes them: { visitor, project?, signals: { utm_content, ... } } and { visitor, project?, value? }) and optionally post_ids. Reads the person's post records and returns posts: one row per place a post was published to that has a count, a visit or a conversion, with post_id, account_id, title, platform_post_id, url, metrics, observed_at, brought ({ visits, conversions, value }, only what was counted) and evidence. A visit counts for a place only when its utm_content is exactly that post's post_id (the post went to one place), the place's own post id, or post_id::account_id; a token that could name several places counts for none. Nothing missing is shown as zero.

post_ids.description: Only these posts (post_id values from tool:read-post-calendar)

observations.description: Each place's own counts for a post

visits.description: First-touch visits with their link signals

conversions.description: Sign-ups or sales by visitor, with value

provenance.source: bitfield-packages packages/content-analytics read-data/post-performance-attribution.ts (the join, unchanged but for its local types), read over the person's post records through the records door

payload.label: Where a post can go
payload.job: List the accounts this person can post to, each ready or not and why, and each place they have no account for yet
payload.description: Reads the person's connection records. Returns destinations: each account_id (the connection id), platform, label, name and ready, with said when it is not ready (a field the place needs that the connection lacks); not_connected: each place with no account yet; and said. Use the account_id values as tool:draft-a-post destinations. It changes nothing.

provenance.source: the posting owner of the person's posts (draft, check, approve, set for its time, take back), moved here with its ready check and place rows; read and written over the person's post and connection records through the records door

payload.label: Draft a post
payload.job: Keep a post as a draft for the person to look at: its words, its video or picture, where it goes and when
payload.description: Give caption (the words), media (the file as the person's files list it: { identity, name?, media_type?, byte_length? }) with media_facts ({ duration_seconds, width, height } the file does not say), destinations (account_id values from tool:list-post-destinations), caption_by_platform ({ platform: words }), settings_by_platform ({ platform: { ... } }, like a video title), link (an https page; it is added after the words, tagged with the post and the place), scheduled_for (a date and time with its zone), time_zone, source ({ kind, id } of the record it came from, kept as given), format_id, reaches (the people it contacts first, each with where they were found) and drafted_by (the AI writing it). Give post_id to change a draft; changing an approved post, or a scheduled one nothing was sent for, makes it a draft again. Returns post, ready (as tool:check-a-post gives it) and said. Nothing is posted.

post_id.description: A post_id from tool:draft-a-post or tool:read-post-calendar

provenance.source: the posting owner of the person's posts (draft, check, approve, set for its time, take back), moved here with its ready check and place rows; read and written over the person's post and connection records through the records door

input.caption: A sample draft that goes nowhere yet

payload.label: Check a post
payload.job: Say whether a post is ready for each place it is going, and what each place will refuse, before it is approved or set to go
payload.description: Give post_id. Returns, for each destination, ready, problems (what that place will refuse, in plain words: words too long, a video or picture it needs, a kind or size of file it does not take, a setting it needs such as a video title) and not_checked (what could not be compared here, such as a video's length nobody gave, or whether the file is still in the person's files); and for the post, ready and said. Fix a problem with tool:draft-a-post. It changes nothing.

post_id.description: A post_id from tool:draft-a-post or tool:read-post-calendar

provenance.source: the posting owner of the person's posts (draft, check, approve, set for its time, take back), moved here with its ready check and place rows; read and written over the person's post and connection records through the records door

payload.label: Approve a post
payload.job: Approve a drafted post exactly as it was reviewed, so it may be set to go
payload.description: Give post_id and expected_values (the complete approval_values of the post as it was reviewed); approval is refused when its words, file, destinations or time changed since. A post going nowhere yet is refused. A post that reaches someone (its words name a @handle, or it lists people in reaches) is approved only by the person on their own screen, never by this tool. approved_by names who approved it. Returns post and said.

post_id.description: A post_id from tool:draft-a-post or tool:read-post-calendar

provenance.source: the posting owner of the person's posts (draft, check, approve, set for its time, take back), moved here with its ready check and place rows; read and written over the person's post and connection records through the records door

payload.label: Set a post to go at its time
payload.job: Set an approved post to go out at its scheduled time, once it is ready for every place it is going; nothing is sent now
payload.description: Give post_id of an approved post whose scheduled_for is still ahead. It is checked for every destination (as tool:check-a-post does); when ready, its status becomes scheduled and it waits for its time, and when not, it stays approved and said gives what each place is missing. Nothing is sent by this tool. tool:take-back-a-post makes a scheduled post a draft again. Returns post_id, status, post, ready and said.

post_id.description: A post_id from tool:draft-a-post or tool:read-post-calendar

provenance.source: the posting owner of the person's posts (draft, check, approve, set for its time, take back), moved here with its ready check and place rows; read and written over the person's post and connection records through the records door

payload.label: Take back a post
payload.job: Take back a post that is waiting for its time and that nothing was sent for, so it is a draft again and goes nowhere
payload.description: Give post_id of a scheduled post nothing was sent for. It becomes a draft again, so its time sends nothing. A post already on its way cannot be taken back. Returns post and said.

post_id.description: A post_id from tool:draft-a-post or tool:read-post-calendar

payload.label: Check the Instagram connection
payload.job: Check that the person's Instagram connection still reaches its account, before a post is set to go there
payload.description: Asks Instagram which account the person's instagram connection signs in as, with the value the person's vault holds for it (placed only as the request leaves, never shown). Returns the account's user_id and username. A refusal (an expired or revoked sign-in) means the person connects Instagram again. It posts nothing and changes nothing.

account_id.description: One of the person's accounts of this kind, service_connection:instagram or service_connection:instagram:<account>, from tool:list-post-destinations

payload.label: Check the Facebook Page connection
payload.job: Check that the person's Facebook connection still reaches its account, before a post is set to go there
payload.description: Asks Facebook which account the person's facebook-messenger connection signs in as, with the value the person's vault holds for it (placed only as the request leaves, never shown). Returns the Page's id and name. A refusal (an expired or revoked sign-in) means the person connects Facebook again. It posts nothing and changes nothing.

account_id.description: One of the person's accounts of this kind, service_connection:facebook-messenger or service_connection:facebook-messenger:<account>, from tool:list-post-destinations

payload.label: Send a post to YouTube
payload.job: Send one of the person's approved posts to one of their YouTube accounts once its time has come, and keep where it went
payload.description: Give post_id (an approved or scheduled post whose time has come) and account_id (one of its destinations: a youtube connection, service_connection:youtube or service_connection:youtube:<account>). The engine hands this run only that account's held values; they reach www.googleapis.com, youtube.googleapis.com only, as each request leaves. The destination is marked not known before sending, so a cut-off send is never repeated by itself: give resend: true only after looking on YouTube. A destination that already has the post is not sent it again. A post with a file hands the place that file from the person's files: a share it streams (a signed link that expires) or the file's bytes streamed to it, never a copy kept here. Returns post_id, status, post (with each destination's status, url and error in plain words) and said. This posts publicly on the person's account: run it only with the person's yes for this post.

post_id.description: A post_id from tool:draft-a-post or tool:read-post-calendar

resend.description: Send again to a destination whose outcome is not known, after looking on the place

provenance.source: the posting owner's send (publish now or at its time) with its held fetch and outcome words, and the facebook-page and substack publishers, moved here; the other places' publishers are @opencoredev/social-sdk 0.5.0 (MIT)
